title: Chapter 777
text:
As soon as he opened the forums, two hot posts jumped into his sight. They were the latest episode of the Galaxy Times and Pork Bun's video.

Both of their titles mentioned him, and the Galaxy Times even used his name as the subtitle of this episode. The title of this episode was' Galaxy Times: Legendary Leader — Black Star '!

"Yo, the Galaxy Times made me into a special episode." Han Xiaoxin was overjoyed.

The Galaxy Times would usually introduce the major events and storylines that the players of the various Star Fields had experienced. Sometimes, they would make a special episode about some major events or people.

For example, when Version 3.0 had just started, the Galaxy Times had made a special episode to analyze the different storylines that the Crimson Tide had brought to the players of the various Star Fields. The secret war in the Shattered Star Ring was just one of them.

If he remembered correctly, although the Galaxy Times had mentioned him many times, this was the first time they had used his name as the subtitle of an episode.

Thinking about it, he was a famous person in several versions and became the first person to step into the Beyond Grade A realm in the players' impression. It was indeed worthy of a special episode.

Han Xiao then looked at Pork Bun's video. The title was' Black Star Corps Special: Rise of the Star Field '.

These two videos were the most popular posts at the moment. Han Xiao did not open them immediately. He was used to glancing at the ordinary posts to see what the other players were talking about recently.

Looking down, countless new posts were refreshed, and the content was almost all about the secret war Main Storyline Mission. Just now, the other players' secret war Main Storyline Missions were also completed at the same time, which surprised many players. This new topic filled the forums instantly.

"What the f * ck, the Main Storyline Mission has been completed? A notification popped up on the interface. I wasn't prepared at all! "

"I just saw the news. Bloodshed Land actually retreated."

"The news said that Purple Crystal originally had little hope. This time, it was the Army Commander who turned the tide and made Klent give up their invasion."

"My Old Black is amazing!"

"The Mission Rating is so high. Is it because we won the secret war?"

"That's for sure. It's written in the details of the Mission Rating that winning the war will raise the Mission Rating by a huge margin!"

"This is too good!"

"The Army Commander is amazing!"

"What are you doing?!"

"Wah, I'm crying. I went to do the Mercenary Alliance's storyline. If I had known that there would be such an additional benefit, I would have participated in the secret war as well. I regret it so much."

"Regret + 1. To the brother above, please hug me and cry with me."

In the forums, most of the Black Star Corps players were overjoyed. This was a Grade S Main Storyline Mission, and its evaluation had been raised by a large margin. The difficulty was extremely high, and this was a blessing from the heavens, allowing the army players to earn a huge sum of money.

Only the army players had such a benefit. Many players were in a good mood and liked Han Xiao even more.

Amidst the excitement, some people who were gloating thought of Summer Night Flower and once again posted the post of him encouraging the army players to betray him, pulling it out and whipping his corpse.

"Summer Night Flower, come out and take a beating!"

"Summer Night Flower, how do you feel now? Are you surprised? Are you surprised? Are you happy?"

"Hey, why aren't you teaching us the right way to play the secret war now?"

"Didn't they say that Bloodshed Land would win? How did it become like this?"

"The truth is in the hands of a few, huh? You're the only one who's clear, huh? Xia Yiji, do you have any new tricks? "

Summer Night Flower had made three guesses back then, but today, the facts had proven that all of them were wrong.

He thought that the Black Star Corps had no way to rise up. Sigh, the Black Star Corps had suddenly become an ally of the Red Empire, and their faction leader, Black Star, had even become a Beyond Grade A Super in the galaxy.

He thought that only Bloodshed Land would win the secret war. Sigh, but now, it was the Black Star Corps that had won.

As for saying that the Black Star Corps had too many people and that the benefits they could share were limited, that was even more nonsense. The army players had made a lot of money, and the group of 'defectors' that had joined Bloodshed Land were being hunted down by the army players to the point that they could barely take care of themselves.

His' prediction post 'had already been pinned to the pillar of shame, and many players were happily Summer Night Flower. Summer Night Flower simply pretended to be dead and did not have the confidence to say anything at all, afraid that he would be criticized by the players and become a deity on the spot.

After scanning the post, Han Xiao returned to the pinned post, opened the new issue of Galaxy Times, and looked at his feature.

The opening was the same male and female hosts. They still had the same friendly smile that made one want to jump into the screen and hit them after looking at them for a long time. They were still speaking the same opening lines that even the audience could remember.

"Hello, players," the female host said. "This is Galaxy Times, dedicated to sharing first-hand game information and protecting your gaming career."

"We only have one topic for today's episode," the male host said. "That is the famous person who has caused a sensation in the galaxy recently, Black Star!"

The scene changed. It was unknown which player had taken a screenshot, but the background was the scene of the battle not long ago.

The perspective of the screenshot was the position of the Black Star Corps, which was behind Han Xiao. In the picture, Han Xiao's back was facing the camera, and in front of him was an endless number of enemy battleships. It was as if he was facing thousands of troops alone. It was very cool to look at.

Then, the show went through the life of Han Xiao's character from the beginning, introduced the rise of the Black Star Corps, and the various major events that the players had participated in.

During the Black Phantom era, he stirred up the situation of Blue Star behind the scenes, started the war single-handedly, and finally took revenge and destroyed the Germinal Organization …

During the Black Star Mercenary era, he led the first batch of professional players to fight in the universe, joined Floating Dragon Island, grew rapidly, and laid the foundation of the future army …

During the Mutation Disaster era, in order to fulfill his promise, he led the Black Star Mercenary, who had already gained a foothold in the universe, back to Blue Star, helped the mother planet to resist the disaster, led the players into the galaxy, and the Black Star Corps was officially born. He assisted Godora to get rid of the infamous Dark-star organization, becoming the rare example of an outsider in Godora's history who received the Golden Gal Badge …

During the secret war era, in the ten years unknown to the players, he developed the Black Star Corps, became a Beyond Grade A, turned the tide of the war single-handedly, helped Purple Crystal win the war, and even allowed the army to join the Universal Civilization Red Empire …

The program used a rather formal tone to recount the history of Han Xiao in the eyes of the players from the beginning, accompanied by some of the Black Star Corps storyline content recorded in the Galaxy Chronicles. It also screened the players' life experiences in the army, adding more interaction to the introduction, showing the nature of the growth of the players and the army together.

At the end of the video, the program gave a concluding comment.

"In just over twenty years, Black Star walked out of his mother planet and established an astonishing foundation in the Shattered Star Ring. From the Black Star of the past to the Black Star that is now famous in the Star Field, we have witnessed his growth. He is the first person we have seen who reached Beyond Grade A through his own growth.

As a leader, he undoubtedly possesses the characteristics of a legend. His ambition, ability, and methods are extraordinary. Even though he has been active in our eyes until now, he has always been like a veil of mystery. We have never completely understood his philosophy and character. There are always many guesses about him, and there are always different opinions.

"No one knows how high the Black Star Corps will achieve under his leadership, but one thing is for sure … we are witnessing the birth of a legend."

The video ended there, and this episode of the Galaxy Times gave a summary of his achievements. It could be considered a more official report.

Han Xiao felt that the benefits were not small. He was an old friend in the eyes of the old players in Version 1.0 and Version 2.0, but the new players in the other Star Fields in Version 3.0 still had limited understanding of him.

This episode of the Galaxy Times was equivalent to introducing him to more new players, and he gained a wave of fame.

"Not bad." Seeing that he was on camera again, Han Xiaoxin was happy and opened Pork Bun's video.

Compared to the official style of the Galaxy Times, Pork Bun's video had a strong tendency to bootlick …

As soon as the video started, the screen was pitch black, and the narration slowly sounded.

Han Xiao suddenly raised his eyebrows. Pork Bun's narration was actually from a first-person perspective, pretending to speak with his identity.

The black screen brewed the atmosphere, covering the already low voice with a layer of mystery.

"When I first gazed at the starry sky, the stars in the sky were like diamonds in the night sky, bright and shining. But in the distant horizon, there were two overlapping stars. The former covered the latter's starlight, turning it into a pitch-black star."

"At that moment, I thought that maybe one day, I could also cover the light of the other stars … so that everyone can only see me.
